2.4.1.2-r1.burton_quote: when he came into a village, considered always what herbs did grow most frequently about it, and those he distilled in a silver limbeck, making use of others amongst them as occasion served

2.4.1.2-r2.burton_quote: to which all the herbalists in the country continually flock

2.4.1.2-r3.burton_quote: Baldus a mountain near the lake Benacus in the territory of Verona, to which all the herbalists in the country continually flock

2.4.1.2-r4.burton_quote: that think they do nothing, except they rake all over India, Arabia, Ethiopia for remedies, and fetch their Physic from the three quarters of the World, and from beyond the Garamantes. Many an old wife or countrywoman doth often more good with a few known and common garden herbs
